title: Cycle-ready Dedicated Onboarding & Autoscale Conformance Playbook
creator: Aisha Rahman
description:
Objective: Create a repeatable, cycle-conscious runbook that guides onboarding of new dedicated customers through capacity reservation, canary rollout, and autoscale conformance testing. The playbook will reduce time-to-production for Dedicated customers, ensure SLO alignment with autoscale behavior, and provide clear acceptance gates for Product, Eng, and Support.

Scope: onboarding steps (account -> reserved pool -> routing rules), autoscale readiness checklist (warm pools, fastpath, fallback models), observability/alerting templates, cost & quota guardrails, and customer-facing checklist for SOC/Security and Finance. Includes templates for canary scenarios, test traffic scripts, and rollback criteria.

Success metrics: average onboarding time reduced to <= 7 days, first-24h error rate during canary < 0.5%, canary-to-production rollback rate < 3% across pilot customers, and clear cost variance alerts firing within 2 hours of anomalous spend.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Rahman), Eng leads (Marco Liu, Priya Desai), SRE (Tomás Ortega), Solutions Eng (Leah Chen), Legal/Compliance reviewer (Sana Patel), Support lead (Diego Morales).

Key deliverables: playbook doc in Confluence, checklist templates (Customer & Internal), two test harness scripts (traffic generator + latency spike), dashboard template (Console) with token-level cost breakouts, one training session for Solutions Eng.

Constraints & trade-offs: We will prioritize deterministic SLO ramps over fastest time-to-onboard; some customers may accept longer prewarm windows to guarantee latency SLAs. This increases short-term unit cost but reduces production incidents. For customers needing rapid onboarding we will offer an "accelerated pilot" that requires extra manual oncall support (explicitly documented in the playbook).
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published with step-by-step checklist and owner table
Canary test plan with 3 defined scenarios (steady state, burst, KV-cache-warmup) uploaded to the test harness repo and passing in CI
Console dashboard template available in the Templates library with predefined alerts and cost breakpoints
Solutions Eng runbook created and validated in a dry run with an internal team
Two pilot customers onboarded using the playbook and SLOs met for 72h without rollback
